newsitem.title: USA: Milestone Properties Inc Q3 full results.
newsitem.headline: Milestone Properties Inc Q3 full results.

text.p: NOTE:(a) In accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, the total revenue for the nine months ended Sept. 30, 1996 includes (i) $2,067,859 of an unrealized holding gain related to one of the company's subsidiaries, Milestone Asset Management Inc. (MAMI), having entered into hedging transactions to mitigate the interest rate risk associated with its purchase of fixed interest rate, commercial mortgage pass-through certificates, and (ii) $203,696 of amortization of discount involving the purchase of such certificates by MAMI.

(b) Includes an unrealized holding loss of $3,031,743 associated with the hedging transactions as described above and $342,776 of amortization of discount involving the purchase of the pass through certificates described above.

(c) In accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, the total revenue for the three months ended Sept. 30, 1996 includes (i) $373,674 of an unrealized holding loss related to MAMI having entered into hedging transactions to mitigate the interest rate risk associated with its purchase of fixed interest rate, commercial mortgage pass-through certificates, and (ii) $77,186 of amortization of discount involving the purchase of such certificates by MAMI.

(d) Includes an unrealized holding loss of $139,499 associated with the hedging transactions as described above and $58,868 of amortization of discount involving the purchase of the pass through certificates described above.
